summary: Temporary admin access request stalled in approval microservice after Okta group migration
description:
Issue summary: Temporary admin elevation requests created by the console are remaining in 'PendingApproval' and never reach approvers. Impact: Multiple deploys and emergency escalations blocked for on-call and contractor teams. The approval microservice (access-approval-svc) shows repeated permission errors when calling Okta APIs after last night's Okta group rename/migration. Expected: Requests transition to 'AwaitingApprover' and email/Slack approvals delivered. Observed: Requests stuck for >3 hours, approvers did not receive notifications.

Initial hypothesis: Access-approval-svc lost permission to read group membership after Okta client credentials rotated without updating the service secret in Vault. Alternatively, group renames changed keys used in the approval mapping table and caused a lookup failure.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create a temporary admin access request from Console > User > 'Elevate access' for a contractor account
2) Observe request created with state 'PendingApproval' in /admin/access-requests
3) Check access-approval-svc logs for the request_id and see repeated 403s to Okta /groups endpoint
4) No approver notification is generated and request does not progress
impact: Blocked production deploys for 3 teams: infra-deploy, ml-serving, and data-pipelines. Two emergency rollbacks delayed. Affected ~8 engineers and 4 contractors requiring temporary elevation.

resolution: Root cause: Okta client credentials were rotated and the new token lacked okta.groups.read scope; additionally a recent Okta group rename broke the mapping lookup. Fix implemented: updated Vault secret with credentials that include required scopes and deployed access-approval-svc change to add tolerant group lookup (fallback to group displayName and a migration mapping table). Workaround: manual approver assignment and temporary grants as per SRE runbook. Follow-up: add automated post-rotation validation for Okta scopes and add alert when approval queue length exceeds threshold.
follow_up_actions: Create alert: access-requests.queue_length > 10 for > 5m -> SRE oncall
Add automation to validate Okta client scopes immediately after credential rotation
Update migration playbook to include mapping-table deploy step and verification
Postmortem to be drafted on Confluence and linked to this ticket
